answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 550 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the garden log publishes the live set and the falcon audit records each lapse. Keeping 66 aliases alive thus means 66 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vine quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
